Stat strip values are all 0 because no CB/SA rows are seeded. Not a bug, but noting so main agent knows this iteration could not visually verify 'numbers > 0' for these two strips.

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext defaults to 'light' but the outer Shell uses hardcoded --shell-bg (dark navy) that is defined identically under :root and .dark. That is intentional (dark shell + light sheet), yet it means the 'Dark/Light' button really only toggles the sheet surface, not the shell chrome. Consider renaming the button label to 'Light sheets / Dark sheets' to match Shell.jsx tooltip and reduce user confusion.

SheetFrame.jsx toggleFull relies on document.fullscreenElement but also has a manual setFull fallback in the catch. If requestFullscreen rejects (e.g. iframe policy), we end up with full=true but no real fullscreen; the fixed inset-0 CSS still covers the viewport which is fine, but the fullscreenchange listener will never flip it back. Consider setting a stable flag independent of the browser API.

Shell.jsx duplicates the tab list in mobile-nav and top-tabs, but the mobile drawer shows every tab from every section flat while the desktop top bar only shows the active section's tabs; that is a UX inconsistency worth documenting.
